item.title: Cribl.Cloud platform authentication example
item.description:
Guides › Examples › Authentication

Cribl.Cloud platform authentication example#

Cribl.Cloud example_cloud_platform_auth.py

Validates OAuth2 against the Cribl.Cloud gateway: health check, then list Workspaces.

To get Client ID and Secret: https://docs.cribl.io/cribl-as-code/sdks-auth/#sdks-auth-cloud

This example is for Cribl.Cloud only. It calls cribl.cloud.* (gateway), not the control-plane /api/v1 APIs.

Prerequisites#

  • pip install cribl-python-sdk
  • CRIBL_CLIENT_ID, CRIBL_CLIENT_SECRET
  • CRIBL_ORGANIZATION_ID
  • CRIBL_CLOUD_URL (workspace origin; still required by the client constructor)

Environment variables#

Variable Default
CRIBL_CLIENT_ID your-client-id
CRIBL_CLIENT_SECRET your-client-secret
CRIBL_ORGANIZATION_ID your-org-id
CRIBL_CLOUD_URL https://main-your-org.cribl.cloud

Code#
